data.name: Covert Commander
data.description: An Okeno liberator grants all allies within 30 feet who are in her line of sight (but not herself) a +i competence bonus on Disguise and Stealth checks. This bonus increases by 1 for every 3 levels beyond 3rd. This ability replaces trap sense.
